claude.performance_metric: ~$2.3bn pre-tax Piceance impairment (2015); net loss $(1,727)m in 2015; revenue declined $2,523m (2014) to $693m (2016)
claude.rationale: The slice documents a financial/portfolio-repositioning trajectory (large Piceance impairment, net losses, revenue decline, asset sales, RKI acquisition, workforce reduction to ~650) but contains no evidence of realized product/operating-process incoherence, so p4_pathway is 0. Likewise, the slice documents no fracture between operations and the people/management/organization over time, so p5_pathway is 0. No archetype incoherence (e.g., merger-of-equals dominance) or business-model incompatibility is described; the registrant remained an independent NYSE-listed company throughout, so t1 and t2 are 0.
